is.t: Seven water samples: fixed order, site, record label, assay IDs and read counts
sample_order 1-7; clean_reads_virome and raw_reads_virome in reads
Full composition of all 59 taxa x 7 samples in three assays, with the display category of each taxon

relative_abundance is a fraction of the sample total within one assay; abundance_sum in assay units (virome: breadth-masked (>= 75%) trimmed-mean coverage normalized to one million per sample; amplicons: relative abundance)
Composition after the frozen display aggregation (top 8 named taxa per amplicon assay, all viral classes)
relative_abundance as above; categories Other and Unclassified are separate
Which taxon was mapped to which display category, with the rule and the 7-sample mean used to rank
Shannon and observed richness per assay and sample, each with its own definition
shannon in nats; observed in features
Masked viral alpha diversity with rarefied and unrarefied values and the rarefaction spread
masked_reads and rarefy_depth in reads; *_sd is technical spread over 100 rarefactions, not a biological interval
Same-site c/d record-label contrasts as saved (difference = dirty minus clean)
shannon in nats; bc2 has no counterpart and is absent
Saved Aitchison PCoA coordinates per assay and sample
PCoA1/PCoA2 are saved ordination scores; axis*_percent are already percentages
F2c (Mantel); table formerly drawn as S1E
All three cross-assay statistics for the three assay pairs: Mantel r, Procrustes correlation and RV coefficient; the ranking of the two virome pairs depends on the statistic

Mantel r (Spearman) and Procrustes correlation are unitless with nominal permutation p (999 permutations, seed 42, no adjustment); Procrustes is full-rank (six axes for seven samples), so only its p is informative; RV is descriptive, with no permutation test in this study

Marginal PERMANOVA for every distance of each assay, location and c/d label terms retained; the virome location term depends on the distance (Aitchison p = 0.725; Bray-Curtis 0.001; Jaccard 0.002) Main-text summary: virome, bact_16s and euk_18s_microeuk, comprising 13 assay–distance combinations. Five additional combinations for euk_18s_all are retained in these tables.

R2 is a proportion; p is nominal over 999 unrestricted permutations; location df = 2, c/d label (water_condition) df = 1; read with S11 because location dispersion is flagged in every assay; a non-significant c/d term is not evidence of no difference

Dispersion checks for every distance and grouping, with the saved status (flagged / method-dependent / not flagged) Main-text summary: virome, bact_16s and euk_18s_microeuk, comprising 13 assay–distance combinations. Five additional combinations for euk_18s_all are retained in these tables.
p values from parametric and permutation tests, with and without bias adjustment
All 200 iPHoP records at score >= 90 with the corrected genus and the visibility status
iphop_confidence is the saved score; visibility is a genus-level match against the filtered 16S table
The 29 strict CRISPR edges (25 vOTUs, 22 genera) with co-detection and mismatch fields
n_codetected_masked counts samples; a separate endpoint from iPHoP with its own denominator
All 3,060 vOTUs with CheckV class, estimated completeness, length and predicted gene count
contig_length_bp in bp; checkv_completeness_pct in % (NA for the 47 Undetermined records)
Masked richness and sequencing depth per sample
Historical saturation diagnostics at full depth from the source project, with the definition of each layer; kept for reference, not evidence of sampling sufficiency

pct_of_chao1 in %; virome rows use unmasked positive counts (not the current alpha definition); Chao1 ratios on denoised, filtered amplicon ASVs are not sampling-sufficiency evidence; new_taxa_per_1Mr is a slope estimate, not an observation from adding a million reads
All 138 AMG candidate KOs x 7 samples
cells are the summed TPM of the vOTUs carrying the KO; not expression or flux
All 68 curated metabolism pathways x 7 samples
Every KO-carrier pair with its per-sample TPM, contribution fraction and rank (KO feature level)
contribution_fraction sums to 1 within a KO; 138 KOs and 544 carrier vOTUs
The frozen 11-row display list with the selection rule and the saved totals
total_TPM as above; rank_total_TPM is the rank among the 138 KOs
Top 1/2/3 and remaining carrier shares for each displayed KO
fraction of the row TPM; ranks are within a row, not the same vOTU across rows
Carriers of the displayed KOs joined to the checked iPHoP >= 90 members
status is the visibility class or 'no iPHoP >= 90 record'
Each defense and anti-defense set with its tool, rule and denominator
vOTUs with at least one call; counts from different tools are not additive
Per-vOTU membership of each tool set and of the anti-defense union, with the predicted gene count
1/0 flags; genomad_n_genes is the predicted gene count used for the bins of F5A
Membership of every NARP-related vOTU under four operational definitions, with its CheckV class
1/0 flags; the definitions are not interchangeable
Coordinates and annotations of ORF101-103 of vOTU0052
bp; strand 1 = plus; aa_length excludes the stop codon
DefenseFinder gene rows for vOTU0052, including the separate atd1 call
hit_i_eval and hit_profile_cov as saved by DefenseFinder

Case values reported in project documents (coverage, HE targeting, ORF102 domains, global NARP), with file and line; the coverage and HE-targeting rows are Tables A and B of Supplementary Note 1 (formerly drawn as S2e, S2f)

see the unit column of each row; these were not exported as separate result tables in the source project. The power row keeps its source label (odds ratio of 3) verbatim; the source script defines that scenario as a threefold Poisson expected count, and the 16% was not recomputed (Supplementary Note 1)
The 20 VF hits with protein coordinates, HSP extent and saved localization
bp; localization is mutually exclusive across the 20 hits
CheckV viral and host region boundaries of the flagged records
The 19 flagged records with gene counts, contamination and the number of VF hits
The four saved negative-binomial models with their two definition axes
IRR with saved 95% Wald CI; dependent sensitivity estimates on the same 3,013 vOTUs
How 3,060 vOTUs relate to the 3,013 used by the models
The three controlled-construct endpoints with their own denominators
constructs; distinct endpoints: the latter two share the 720 flanked constructs as denominator but their events do not overlap; do not combine into an overall failure rate
Provirus flag rate per viral window and flank proportion
constructs; the length gradient is only comparable at a fixed flank proportion
The 33 individual constructs retaining less than 95% of viral bases
Community-side gaps: what was not exported or not done in the source project
Function-side gaps: analyses done in the source project whose per-item tables were not exported
Taxonomy of every feature of the three assays, the table behind the composition sheets
text; one row per feature and assay
The 47 vOTU IDs excluded from the four models, with the reason
vOTU IDs; excluded only from models needing the completeness covariate, kept in F1 and F5A
Per-stratum viral-retention and host-flank-removal results for the controlled constructs described in Supplementary Note 3
means with saved low/high bounds; fractions unless stated
The gene rows behind the KO co-occurrence rule (K03462 + K13522) with coordinates and hits
Carrier contributions at the curated-pathway feature level: the rows behind the pathway matrix S18
as S19 but per pathway; 68 pathways and 532 carrier vOTUs; contribution_fraction sums to 1 within a pathway
Carrier contributions at the dbID feature level: the widest AMG carrier definition
as S19 but per database entry; 145 entries and 560 carrier vOTUs; this is the 560 of Supplementary Table S1
The 16 vOTUs that carry an AMG dbID entry but none of the 138 KOs, i.e. the difference between the 560 and the 544
Per-sample abundance of candidate VF carriers under the four annotation definitions, with the technical normalization denominators

percentages of the breadth-masked catalogue of the same sample; carriers counted once each; top_two_share has its own denominator (that sample's summed carrier abundance); the PMCR columns are an EXPLORATORY technical diagnostic, not a load or concentration
All 114 filtered-annotation carriers in all seven samples: depth, breadth, detection, catalogue share, eligibility under each definition and the heatmap selection
798 carrier x sample cells; percent_of_catalogue uses the full-catalogue denominator; detected requires covered_fraction >= 0.75 at contig level and does not establish coverage of an annotated locus
All 143 filtered VFDB-A matches with identity, coverage, strict status, region localization and inclusion under each definition
one row per (vOTU_id, query, target); localization no_region_prediction means no coordinate record in this batch, NOT a confirmed viral position
Per-sample detail behind the co-detection counts of Figure 2d: each of the 200 iPHoP records and 29 strict CRISPR edges in each of the seven samples
1,603 rows (229 x 7); codetected = vOTU breadth-masked count > 0 and host genus 16S count > 0 in that sample; co-occurrence only, not infection; genus_detected_16s is NA where the genus is unresolved

Read-subsampling curves within the retained count tables: expected features observed when n reads are drawn from a sample's own reads, for unmasked and breadth-masked virome counts, filtered 16S ASVs and microeukaryote 18S ASVs

analytical rarefaction expectation (Hurlbert), interpolated up to each sample's observed total, never extrapolated; 18S reads are drawn from all 18S reads and only non-metazoan ASVs counted; the 75% breadth mask is decided at full depth and not re-evaluated in subsamples, so a flat masked-virome curve describes subsampling stability of the retained set, not complete sampling of the environment
Short display names of the 11 KO rows of Figure 3a, one row per KO, with the full KO annotation and the basis for each name

KO is the row identity; short_label is a display name only (gene symbols italic, enzyme or function names upright); annotation_full is the KO name as used for the figure selection; no rows are grouped by label
Abundance of the five DefenseFinder NARP2-carrying vOTUs and the two other nadM (K13522) carriers in each of the seven samples

49 rows (7 vOTUs x 7 samples); catalogue_percent = masked trimmed TPM / 10,000, i.e. percent of the whole breadth-masked catalogue in that sample (no renormalization to these vOTUs); 0 where covered fraction < 0.75, which is not absence from the water
DefenseFinder subtypes and PADLOC system types called on the local catalogue, with carrier counts, CheckV classes and notes on selected candidates

26 types (DefenseFinder 18 anti-defense and 4 defense; PADLOC 4 defense-related); carrier counts per type are not additive (a vOTU can carry several types: 112 type-level vs 106 distinct DefenseFinder anti-defense carriers); not all dbAPIS profiles; n_same_protein_dbapis_votu is empty for PADLOC (not applicable)
Both positions of the three designated comparisons: contribution of the fixed shared qualifying set and of position-only qualifying members
six rows; each sample uses its own whole breadth-masked catalogue depth denominator; shared counts are not retention rates; opposite-side weak mapping is diagnostic, not reliable detection or absence
Both positions of the three designated comparisons under all four existing VF definitions, with shared and position-only carrier contributions and mapping diagnostics

24 rows; *_catalogue_percent uses the entire sample-specific masked catalogue; shared_percent_of_VF instead uses the VF-carrier total and is NA when that total is zero; no transport or removal inference
All observed exact seven-sample qualification patterns, intersection counts and their sample-specific abundance contributions
One pattern per row; abundance percentages use each entire masked sample catalogue; patterns are exclusive, not all pairwise inclusive intersections
Seven sample totals and the member counts and abundance contributions of sample-only versus other-sample-shared members
Shared means qualifies in at least one other of all seven samples, not the designated wastewater/reclaimed-water comparisons of S54-S55; percentages sum to 100 per sample
Complete catalogue register of exact membership, seven qualification flags and full-catalogue abundance contributions
All catalogue representatives retained; seven-character bit strings follow configured sample order; qualification is breadth >=0.75 and positive masked depth
All AMG-export KO carriers with the retained primary host prediction and same-sample co-detection status, including unresolved carriers
One row per carrier, not only successful links; candidate host context, not infection; strict CRISPR is a subset of existing evidence
Every KO-carrier association among carriers with a retained primary predicted host genus co-detected in the same sample
Association weight is one per KO-carrier path, not abundance, distinct genes, activity or flux; selected subset of S59
Complete descriptive carrier proportions for six candidate sets under both operational lifestyle rules, with sequence-length and recovery context
All 3060 catalogue records; each vOTU counted once within each set; overlapping sets; unadjusted binary proportions, not the 3013-record hit-rate models
Median-distance diagnostic on representatives without DTR/ITR flags; AMG/KO comparison annotation sets.
Gene sites, bp and dimensionless ratios; gene-site bootstrap percentile interval, not biological replication or equivalence.
18 VF-bearing terminal-repeat-flagged representatives, with predicted region and CheckV records.
Contigs, bp and percentages; flags and completeness estimates do not establish viral provenance.
29 VFDB matches on DTR/ITR representatives; retains eight predicted-host assignments.
Matches, bp and percentages; localization is predicted, and no_region_prediction remains unresolved.
Complete catalogue membership and abundance register for the three designated comparisons
Original sample denominators and F0/F1/S0/S1 eligibility are preserved; percentages are catalogue-relative.
Counts are vOTUs; depths are trimmed mean coverage sums; breadth_threshold is a fraction.
Original definitions, denominators and source labels are retained.
The 83 co-detected virus-host links drawn in Supplementary Fig. S2c
Sample columns are co-detection flags; iPHoP scores are prediction scores.
